events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, we remember Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur today. His music continues to resonate, shaping hip-hop and beyond. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix today. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: Abbey Road released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: On this day, we celebrate The Beatles' 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those songs... pure genius. What's your favourite from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today. She was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman, still rocking hard. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today. He was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation, still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975. The album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the release of John Lennon's 'Imagine'. A song that still inspires peace and unity around the world. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when the iPod changed everything? On this day in 2001, Apple launched a device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you fill yours with?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrate James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, 007 is a cinematic icon. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. He was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today. He was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliantly funny John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day, we celebrate The Beatles' 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track from the double LP is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly unforgettable. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: On this day, we celebrate The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant shift in their sound and influence. What's your top track from the record?
